{{Quote|That crevice must lead into the mineshafts! The planet's ''riddled'' with them!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Keep the Faith!">{{TCWComicCite|6.2|Keep the Faith!}}</ref>}}
'''Taronda''' was a remote [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. [[21 BBY/Legends|During]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to negotiate a trading agreement with the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of the planet for raw materials for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Before negotiations could start however, the planet was [[Battle of Taronda|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Outnumbering the Republic forces, the Separatists had them pinned down under their own deflector shield. The Republic forces were saved by the arrival of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].
